name: Sow Crops
description: Plant seeds in tilled soil for the growing season.

name: Tend Crops
description: Water, weed, and care for growing crops.

name: Harvest Crops
description: Collect mature crops from the field.

name: Mine Ore
description: Extract iron, copper, tin, or coal from ore veins.

name: Quarry Stone
description: Extract limestone or granite from the quarry.

name: Fell Trees
description: Harvest wood logs from forest terrain.

name: Catch Fish
description: Catch raw fish from rivers and ponds.

name: Gather Herbs
description: Collect medicinal herbs from the garden.

name: Tend Livestock
description: Feed, shear, and milk animals in the pasture.

name: Tend Apiary
description: Harvest honey and beeswax from the apiary.

name: Craft / Produce
description: Execute any crafting recipe at the appropriate workstation.

name: Haul Materials
description: Move items between inventories and storage locations.

name: Build Structure
description: Execute a construction job to build walls, floors, or furniture.

name: Deconstruct
description: Remove a structure, recovering some materials.

name: Patrol Area
description: Walk a patrol route and detect threats to the settlement.

name: Stand Watch
description: Stationary guard duty at a watch point.

name: Sell Goods
description: Merchant sells goods to buyers at the market.

name: Purchase Goods
description: Buyer-initiated trade at the market.

name: Deliver Sermon
description: Priest preaches to the congregation in a chapel or church.

name: Personal Prayer
description: Individual devotion at a place of worship.

name: Diplomatic Mission
description: Envoy delivery for diplomatic purposes.

name: Bury Deceased
description: Transport a body to the cemetery for burial.
